name: The Toymaker's Masterpiece
summary: Gadof Blinsky, Vallaki's toymaker, has wanted all his life to see the clockwork jester his master's master made for the count's children.

stages.journal: Goodwife Marta says Blinsky the toymaker asks every stranger if they've been up to the castle, and whether a jester his old master made still walks there.
objectives: Ask Blinsky about the jester, at Blinsky Toys in Vallaki

stages.journal: Fritz von Weerg, Blinsky's master's master, made a jester for the count's children that walked and juggled and bowed. Blinsky would give everything in his shop to see it once. They say it still walks the castle stairs.
objectives: Find von Weerg's jester in Castle Ravenloft

stages.journal: Von Weerg's jester is Pidlwick II, of the castle's high stair. He's afraid of toymakers, but he's agreed to meet this one.
objectives: Bring Pidlwick II to Blinsky Toys in Vallaki

stages.journal: Pidlwick II lives at Blinsky Toys now, juggling in the window for the children of Vallaki. Blinsky finished his masterwork for us: a black stone horse with the knees exactly right.

Pidlwick II met Blinsky, and will go back to him once the castle is done with; the cards say he's needed first. Blinsky finished his masterwork for us: a black stone horse with the knees exactly right.
